- [EVENT] User inquired about precautions for visitors to Mount Sakurajima during or after an eruption.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Visitors should stay alert for warnings and guidance from local authorities and adhere to their advice.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Visitors should wear appropriate protective gear such as a dust mask, goggles, and long-sleeved clothing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Visitors should avoid inhaling volcanic ash or gases, which can cause respiratory problems and irritation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Visitors should stay away from lava, pyroclastic flows, and other hazardous areas.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Visitors should avoid touching or eating volcanic ash, which can be harmful to health.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Visitors should drive carefully and avoid low-lying areas or places close to the sea, as they may be vulnerable to flooding or tsunamis.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Visitors should be prepared for power outages, transportation disruptions, and other inconveniences that may occur during or after an eruption.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Visitors should follow local regulations and respect the environment by not littering or disrupting natural habitats.
